eturn%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%203(c)%20Laplacian-of-Gaussian%20(LoG)%20on%20the%20Gaussian%20Pyramid%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Using%20the%20Gaussian%20pyramid%20constructed%20in%203(a)%2C%20compute%20the%20Laplacian-of-Gaussian%20response%20for%20each%20pyramid%20level.%20Each%20level%20corresponds%20to%20a%20downsampled%20version%20of%20the%20image%20that%20has%20been%20smoothed%20with%20a%20Gaussian%20of%20increasing%20%24%5Csigma%24.%20For%20each%20level%2C%20evaluate%20the%20LoG%20at%20the%20same%20nominal%20smoothing%20scales%20%24%5Csigma%20%5Cin%20%5C%7B1%2C%202%2C%204%2C%208%5C%7D%24%2C%20relative%20to%20that%20level's%20resolution.%20Detect%20local%20extrema%20(both%20maxima%20and%20minima)%20that%20correspond%20to%20blob%20centres.%20Visualize%20the%20strongest%20responses%20as%20circles%20centred%20at%20the%20detected%20locations%2C%20with%20radii%20proportional%20to%20the%20effective%20%24%5Csigma%24%20in%20the%20original%20image%20coordinates.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%20**Note%3A**%20The%20Laplacian-of-Gaussian%20(LoG)%20response%20can%20be%20computed%20in%20two%20conceptually%20different%20ways%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%201.%20On%20the%20original%20full-resolution%20image%20at%20multiple%20smoothing%20scales%20%24%5Csigma%24%20(pure%20scale-space%20analysis)%2C%20where%20only%20the%20filter%20scale%20changes%2C%20not%20the%20image%20sampling.%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%202.%20On%20the%20Gaussian%20pyramid%2C%20where%20each%20level%20is%20both%20smoothed%20and%20downsampled.%20This%20approach%2C%20used%20in%20practice%20by%20methods%20such%20as%20SIFT%2C%20provides%20a%20computationally%20efficient%20approximation%20to%20the%20continuous%20scale-space%20while%20capturing%20the%20effects%20of%20both%20scale%20and%20resolution.%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%3E%20In%20this%20exercise%2C%20the%20LoG%20is%20applied%20to%20each%20downsampled%20pyramid%20level%20to%20explore%20how%20feature%20detection%20behaves%20under%20changes%20in%20both%20image%20scale%20and%20sampling%20resolution.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20First%2C%20compute%20%60effective_sigma(factor%2C%20sigma)%60.%20A%20level%20downsampled%20by%20%24f%24%20was%20already%20smoothed%20at%20%24%5Csigma%20%3D%20f%24%20in%20original%20pixels%2C%20and%20filtering%20it%20at%20%24%5Csigma%24%20level%20pixels%20adds%20a%20blur%20of%20%24f%5Csigma%24%20original%20pixels.%20Gaussian%20variances%20add%2C%20so%20the%20effective%20scale%20in%20original-image%20pixels%20is%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%24%24%0A%20%20%20%20%5Csigma_%7B%5Cmathrm%7Beff%7D%7D%20%3D%20%5Csqrt%7Bf%5E2%20%2B%20(f%5Csigma)%5E2%7D.%0A%20%20%20%20%24%24%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.function%0Adef%20effective_sigma(factor%2C%20sigma)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22Return%20the%20scale%2C%20in%20original%20pixels%2C%20of%20sigma%20applied%20to%20the%20level%20downsampled%20by%20factor.%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20import%20numpy%20as%20np%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20EDIT%20BELOW%0A%20%20%20%20sigma_eff%20%3D%20np.sqrt((factor%20**%202)%20%2B%20((factor%20*%20sigma)%20**%202))%0A%0A%20%20%20%20return%20sigma_eff%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20Next%2C%20complete%20%60pyramid_extrema(levels%2C%20factors%2C%20sigmas%2C%20method%3D%22log%22)%60.%20For%20every%20level%20(with%20downsampling%20factor%20%60f%60)%20and%20every%20%24%5Csigma%24%20in%20%60sigmas%60%2C%20compute%20the%20response%20with%20%60log_response(level%2C%20sigma)%60%2C%20or%20with%20%60dog_response(level%2C%20sigma)%60%20when%20%60method%3D%22dog%22%60%20(used%20in%203(d)).%20Find%20its%20strongest%20local%20extrema%2C%20both%20maxima%20and%20minima%2C%20with%20your%20%60local_extrema%60%20from%202(d).%20For%20every%20extremum%2C%20append%20the%20row%20%60(row%2C%20column%2C%20f%2C%20sigma_eff)%60%2C%20where%20%60(row%2C%20column)%60%20is%20in%20level%20pixels.%20Return%20a%20floating-point%20array%20
